Starting point

This is what customers see today

Screenshots taken from your live site on 25 October 2026.

What it costs you

Six things quietly losing you orders

  • 01
    Offers arrive as broken text

    Emoji in the red bar render as empty boxes. The ₹10,000 free-pack offer looks like a system error, not a reason to buy.

  • 02
    The product list feels like a spreadsheet

    Three columns of identical yellow boxes. Nothing looks like a gift, so nothing feels worth ₹5,000.

  • 03
    72 items have no photo at all

    They show one “WOW SALE” placeholder or the company logo. A customer cannot tell a sparkler from a sky shot.

  • 04
    Searching is guesswork

    You must know the exact spelling of a product name. There are no filters by category, price or type.

  • 05
    The order total is invisible

    MRP, savings and total sit in three small boxes. Customers cannot see the deal working in their favour.

  • 06
    It is painful on a phone

    Most of your buyers are on a phone in a WhatsApp chat. Today the offer bar fills half the screen before they see a single product.

The redesign

Give 288 crackers a shopfront

89%discount shown clearly on every product
288items, each with a real packshot
36categories you can filter instantly
0broken emoji and empty boxes

Your strongest sales lever

The ₹10,000 offer, turned into a meter

  • →
    “Add ₹4,300 more to unlock the free pack”

    A customer can always see how close they are — and what to do next. That is the difference between a discount and an incentive.

  • →
    Transport charges, stated honestly

    ₹250–₹700, rising in season, confirmed before dispatch. Saying it up front removes the biggest reason for an argument later.

The biggest change

From price sheet to product shelf

Real photos of the actual boxes · MRP struck through · discount badge · add-to-list on every card.

Straight talk

One thing only you can fix

  • !
    72 items have no photograph anywhere

    Your site shows the same “WOW SALE” placeholder or the logo for all of them — sparklers, sky-shot pipes, gift boxes, 1000/2000/5000 wala.

  • ✓
    What we did instead

    Labelled illustrations of the right cracker type, so nothing looks broken or misleading while you collect real photos.

Ask

Send us photos of those 72 boxes from your godown. Half a day with a phone and a white sheet is enough — and the site becomes complete. We will drop them in at no extra cost.
